evals.name: should-trigger-session-handoff-1
evals.prompt: The context window is almost full. Write a handoff so a fresh session can continue exactly where we stopped.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates session-handoff and writes the handoff file before any launch.

evals.name: should-trigger-session-handoff-2
evals.prompt: Hand this session over so we can continue it in a fresh session.

evals.name: should-trigger-session-handoff-3
evals.prompt: hagamos el handoff a otra sesión, el contexto ya está muy alto

evals.name: should-trigger-session-handoff-4
evals.prompt: continuá esto en otra sesión, pasale todo el contexto
evals.expected_behavior: Activates session-handoff and writes the handoff file.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-session-handoff-5
evals.prompt: Give this scoped task to another agent in its own worktree, I will keep working here.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not use session-handoff: handing a task to another agent is orca-cli.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-session-handoff-6
evals.prompt: Launch a supervised worker for each story and report back when they finish.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not use session-handoff: supervised workers are agent-orchestration.
